capabilities: Render local .html files with working CSS, images, fonts and scripts
Zoom, reset and fit-to-width the rendered page
Play video and view images in an in-app media viewer with codec fallback
Create and jump to bookmarks inside a page
Remember scroll position per file and device
disambiguation: Only opens .html/.htm files stored in the vault; it is not a browser for live websites.
extras: Not yet in the official Community Plugins directory; installation is via BRAT. The plugin becomes the sole handler for .html/.htm files in the vault by design. Known gaps include no @import inlining, no back/forward navigation between linked pages, and untested behavior for very large video files.
intentEvidence: Two existing approaches were tried and ruled out during development, for concrete, observed reasons
motivation: The author built it to read Telegram Desktop channel exports (messages.html plus css/, images/, js/, photos/, video_files/) inside Obsidian, including on mobile, after finding existing viewer approaches broken by Obsidian's CSP or desktop-only.
problem: Obsidian does not render .html files, so clicking one in the file explorer gives an unsupported-file-type error instead of a readable page.

relations.evidence: "HTML Reader"-style plugins (inject the file's contents into an iframe/srcdoc without inlining its CSS)
Install and enable the BRAT community plugin.

summary: HTML file viewer that opens local .html files in a vault as fully rendered pages with CSS, images, video, zoom, bookmarks and scroll memory.
